description: This file defines the LoginScreen widget for a Flutter frontend. It manages user login via a form, interacts with an AuthProvider for authentication, and navigates to other screens. It contains UI elements for email/password input, validation, and login actions.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: Stateless widget that serves as the login page and handles navigation to registration.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing form inputs, validation, authentication logic, and UI updates for the LoginScreen.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the LoginScreen widget.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of controllers when the widget is removed.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles login submission by validating form, calling auth provider, and navigating or showing error message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen UI.
